method: Static fixtures only. Run trigger prompts and output cases (with-skill versus baseline/old-skill) in fresh Kiro sessions; record per run the client version, model, discoverable skill set and loaded skill(s). Claude Code runs use the untracked .claude copy (its fixtures carry the pattadar-security-review name) and follow agent-skill-maintenance references/evaluation-method.md. Built-in, global and third-party skills appear only in prompt and required_stop text because the schema cannot name them. Label each run with its client and keep Kiro and Claude Code results apart; store raw runs under ignored .kiro/skill-eval-workspace and commit only reviewed redacted summaries.
